ledger.x: 206: Xiang Yu makes Tian An King of Jibei.
206: the Kingdom of Jibei ends with Tian An.

wars.name: Tian Rong's conquest of Jibei and Jiaodong
wars.outcome: Tian Rong killed the kings of Jiaodong and Jibei (Tian Fu and Tian An on the Timeline) and drove out Tian Du, reuniting the three Qis; Xiang Yu then campaigned in Qi (Timeline: 205).

certainty.note: 'Northern Shandong' is all the pages say; Cliopatria's outline is an approximation.
